This is the new Cadillac Escalade!

It’s the king of American SUVs, but has Cadillac done enough to make this latest version a genuine alternative to the best-of-British Range Rover? Let’s find out…

Mat’s driving the top-spec Platinum Sport edition today. It looks mean with all that blacked-out trim, but under the hood, we’ve got the ‘entry-level’ engine - a 6.2-litre naturally aspirated V8 pumping out 426hp and 623Nm. But does this massive SUV actually need a supercharger, or is the standard V8 all the Escalade you’ll ever need?

On the outside, the Escalade is as subtle as a sledgehammer. The 2025 refresh brings slimmer, vertical LED headlights and a massive grille that could swallow a small hatchback. Being the Sport Platinum, this car ditches the chrome for a darker, more aggressive look, sitting on gargantuan 24-inch alloy wheels.
